name: LEGO Technic Ford Bronco SUV
description: 943 pieces, ages 9+. Opening doors, front-axle suspension and a live rear axle.
notes: RRP £54.99 at LEGO UK; seen at £43.99 (Smyths) and £49.99 (John Lewis), Sept 2026.

name: LEGO Games Minotaurus
description: A buildable board game: 211 pieces, with a Minotaur and a maze you build before you play.
notes: Retired February 2013; original RRP £17.99. Used, complete copies go for roughly £10-£20 and sealed ones for around £40, Sept 2026. Check it is complete (all pieces and the die) before selling.

notes: RRP £389.99; retired July 2026, so new stock is running out. Seen at £364.99 (Smyths) and £300-£420 on eBay UK, Sept 2026.

name: LEGO Technic Ferrari SF-24 F1 Car

notes: RRP £199.99; seen from £139.99 to £169.99 new, Sept 2026. The other Technic Ferrari in case this is the one you meant.
